title: AWARD OF BID NO. F-1292 TO HOLMAN CRAFTSMEN, INC. DBA HCI DOCKS FOR TWO DOCKS WITH GANGWAYS FOR THE CABRILLO BEACH AQUATIC COMMUNITY CENTER
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - AWARD OF BID NO. F-1292 TO HOLMAN CRAFTSMEN, INC. DBA HCI DOCKS FOR TWO DOCKS WITH GANGWAYS FOR THE CABRILLO BEACH AQUATIC COMMUNITY CENTER
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of Bid No. F-1292 (Contract) with Holman Craftsmen, Inc. dba HCI Docks (HCI Docks), located in Oakdale, California, for the one-time purchase and installation of two docks with gangways for the Cabrillo Beach Aquatic Community Center (CBACC) in order to prepare the site for sailing training for the LA28 Olympic Games. The proposed one-time purchase and installation is for a total amount of $160,661.00 plus $12,251.95 in tax for a not-to-exceed amount of $172,912.95. The Harbor Department will be financially responsible for the costs incurred under the proposed Contract. The proposed Contract is associated with the City of Los Angeles Harbor Department's (Harbor Department) Strategic Plan Objective 4: Strong Relationships with Stakeholders, Initiative 1, which delivers key LA Waterfront development projects on time and on budget; attracts visitors to the LA Waterfront; and identifies other public investment opportunities.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Class 2(l) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve Bid No. F-1292 with Holman Craftsmen, Inc. dba HCI Docks; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to Bid No. F-1292; and 4) adopt Resolution No. ___________.
Waterfront & Commercial Real Estate
summary: The Port would buy and install two docks with gangways at the Cabrillo Beach Aquatic Community Center, to prepare the site for LA28 Olympic sailing training, for up to $172,912.95.
